jobs.title: Systems Analyst
jobs.description:
**Position Summary:**

The Systems Analyst acts as the foundation for Meriplex’s Technical Assistance Center (TAC) and reports to a TAC Manager. This role works within the TAC’s ticketing system to resolve Level 1 end user issues. The Systems Analyst must deliver exemplary customer service while following all SOPs to complete customer requests. The person in this position is responsible for an array of end-user issues ranging from general desktop diagnostics to customer specific application support.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Deliver general workstation support.
* Provide customer specific application support.
* Troubleshoot basic network connectivity and devices/user connectivity.
* Administer incident response system reboots.
* Perform basic OS support.
* Utilize basic Azure support skills.
* Provide first level triage virtual server support to reestablish functionality.
* Driven to follow all SOP to resolve all technical issues.
* Navigate Active Directory to enact distribution groups and create, change, and disable users.
* Perform basic ITIL security to provide basic printing and connectivity support.
* Deliver scripted application support.
* TCP/IP troubleshooting abilities.
* Able to perform basic VPN connectivity issues and password resets.
* Basic end-user email support.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

* Basic knowledge of Microsoft 365 applications.
* Basic knowledge of command line.
* Understanding of basic technical triage methodologies.
* Basic TCP/IP understanding.
* Ability to communicate both verbal and written technical information to a wide range of end-users.
* Ability to effectively set expectations regarding delivery of service.
* Strengthen customer relationships by providing exemplary customer service.
* Ability to work in a team environment; contribute as a team member and treat co-workers, subordinates, and customers with respect.
* Adherence to ticketing methodologies regarding documentation, process, and workflow.
* Support, manage, troubleshoot, and resolve service requests with the appropriate level of urgency and professionalism.
* Properly manage workflow using research, documentation, RMM tools, ticket system, and communication.

**Preferred Education, Experience, and Certifications:**

* Prior MSP support desk experience, highly encouraged.
* A+ certification.
* Network+ certification.
* Server+ certification.
* Azure support.
* Superior reading, writing, and communication skills.
* Basic knowledge of network concepts, devices, and best practices.
* Basic Microsoft 365 certification.

**Compensation:** $25.00 - $31.00 / hour

**Work Schedule/Travel:**

* Meriplex’s TAC operates 24/7 - both workday and after hours shifts available, Monday – Sunday.
* Estimated 0% travel required.

**Physical Demands:**

Sedentary Work – Exerts up to 50 pounds of force occasionally, a negligible amount of force frequently, and/or constantly having to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time.

jobs.description:
Proconex is the exclusive Emerson Impact Partner for Emerson Automation Solutions in the Mid-Atlantic region. We provide a full portfolio of Process Automation Control Systems, Valves and Control Devices, and related technologies and services to a range of customers—in the Life Sciences, Chemical, Power, Refining, Oil & Gas, Food & Beverage, Paper, Metals, and other industries, as well as commercial enterprises and campus facilities. With three strategically located offices, Proconex maintains a deep dedication to its 200+ employees, a sharp focus on safety and quality, and the drive to deliver.

**Business Systems Analyst**

**Job Overview**

The Business Systems Analyst serves as the bridge between business operations and technology, driving process improvement, system optimization, reporting, and digital transformation initiatives across the organization. This role partners with stakeholders throughout the company to understand operational challenges, identify opportunities for improvement, and deliver scalable technology solutions that improve efficiency, visibility, and decision-making.

The Business Systems Analyst will work extensively with ERP systems, business process automation, analytics platforms, reporting tools, and emerging AI technologies to support organizational goals. Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, business acumen, technical aptitude, and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

This position supports process analysis, systems optimization, reporting, automation, and technology adoption efforts across the organization while serving as a key liaison between business stakeholders and technology resources.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Business Process Improvement**

* Analyze existing business processes, workflows, and operational procedures.
* Identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and areas for automation.
* Facilitate process improvement initiatives across departments.
* Document current-state and future-state workflows.
* Recommend solutions that improve efficiency, data quality, user experience, and business visibility.
* Identify and implement opportunities for operational improvement through continuous improvement initiatives.

**Business Systems Administration & Optimization**

* Partner with business teams to enhance and optimize enterprise applications.
* Support ERP configuration, testing, implementation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Gather and document business requirements for system enhancements.
* Assist with user acceptance testing (UAT), issue resolution, and change management activities.
* Ensure business systems align with organizational objectives and industry best practices.
* Support user adoption and utilization of business systems through training, communication, and support.

**Data & Analytics**

* Develop dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using approved analytics tools.
* Translate business questions into meaningful metrics and reporting solutions.
* Analyze datasets to identify trends, opportunities, and performance insights.
* Promote data governance and reporting standards.
* Support self-service analytics adoption across the organization.
* Deliver reporting and business intelligence solutions that improve organizational visibility and decision-making.

**Automation & Digital Transformation**

* Identify opportunities to automate manual processes using modern technology platforms.
* Support workflow automation initiatives and business application integrations.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI-enabled solutions, and recommend practical business applications.
* Participate in digital transformation projects from concept through implementation.
* Support the reduction of manual effort and improvement of operational scalability through technology-enabled solutions.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Serve as a liaison and partner to business leaders and subject matter experts.
* Facilitate discovery sessions and requirements-gathering workshops.
* Communicate project status, recommendations, risks, and business impacts to stakeholders.
* Provide user training, documentation, and adoption support for new solutions.
* Develop and maintain cross-functional relationships that support project delivery and organizational change.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field.
* 3+ years of experience in business analysis, business systems, process improvement, analytics, or related roles.
* 3+ years of experience gathering requirements and translating business needs into technical solutions.
* 3+ years of experience applying analytical and problem-solving skills in a business environment.
* 2+ years of experience utilizing written and verbal communication skills in a professional setting.
* 2+ years of experience managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

* Experience with ERP platforms (IFS, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar).

* Knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
* Experience with workflow automation platforms.
* Exposure to AI-powered business solutions and digital transformation initiatives.
* Experience supporting change management, user adoption, and business process transformation efforts.

Overview:

***The Michaels Organization is a national leader in residential real estate offering full-service capabilities in development, property management, construction, and investment. At Michaels, our teammates strive to fulfill our promise of creating communities that lift lives – ones that jumpstart housing, education, civic engagement, and neighborhood prosperity. Reporting to the Director HR System and Services, the HR Systems Analyst is responsible for the system and content administration of the HRMS Platform to meet The Michaels Organizations business needs. This role involves managing and supporting the SuccessFactors environment daily. As a subject matter expert, the HR System Analyst collaborates with HR team members, HR Operations, and key business partners to optimize the system, provide recommendations for improvements, manage and analyze data, facilitate workflow, improve efficiency, troubleshoot, and enhance the platform to meet operational needs.

Responsibilities:

* Administer and support the HRMS Platform, including various modules: Employee Central, Role-Based Provisioning, Goals and Performance, Calibration, Career Development Planning, Succession, Onboarding, LMS, and Reporting.
* Understand, configure, and optimize Employee Central, including metadata framework, object definitions, business rules, workflows, portlet/tile details, and replication.
* Ensure compliance with best practices in systemic processes, data governance, and security protocols.
* Oversee day-to-day system operations, special projects, and bi-annual releases.
* Conduct thorough testing of system changes in Preview/Test and Production environments.
* Manage and support integrations with third-party vendor solutions.
* Serve as the primary contact between users, the HRMS, and other internal systems.
* Implement HRMS modules through scoping, planning, process design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support.
* Collaborate with key business partners to recommend and implement business process and system improvements.
* Support organizational communication and change management efforts related to system changes, including documentation, reporting assistance, and end-user orientation.
* Perform root cause analysis for system problems, including solutions and recommendations.
* Ensure HRIS data quality and integrity by implementing necessary point-of-entry validations and workflow checkpoints.

Qualifications:

**Required Experience:**  

* Minimum 5 years’ experience implementing, using and supporting HR systems, including at least 3 years’ experience in HRMS administration/system management in a corporate environment.
* Experience administrating/managing multiple HRMS modules required.

**Required Education/Training:**  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Sciences or Human Resources field, or equivalent experience required.
* Holds current Certification(s) in HRMS Foundations and module Administration

**Required Skills and Abilities:**  

* Experience with HRMS Solution/Service Implementation practices and processes.
* Proficient in systems implementation skills including requirements/process analysis, conceptual and detailed design, configuration, testing, training, change management, and post-deployment support.
* Strong understanding of HRMS Organization Management & Personnel Administration (OM & PA) including the Hire-to-Retire business process overall.
* Experienced with Role-based permissions, MDF, and Business Configuration UI.
* Deep understanding of integrations and interoperability between all HRMS modules.
* Working understanding of HRIS reporting and payroll.
* Ability to facilitate and lead complex discussions in mixed technical and business team environments.
* Excellent interviewing skills to gather business/functional requirements from users and technical staff, applying system and business acumen to verify business needs.
* Strong critical thinking and planning skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills to clearly present complex information to business stakeholders.
* Outstanding customer service skills with the ability to analyze needs and act on stakeholder feedback.
* Self-directed with the ability to work independently and find/develop solutions for business requirements.
* Thrive in a fast-paced environment with minimal supervision, working with both in-person and virtual teams.
* Experience with PMO & Agile methodologies.
* Know and follow departmental and company policies and procedures, and communicate effectively to foster a positive work environment.
* Collaborate with colleagues, offer suggestions, accept feedback, resolve problems, and maintain productivity with organizational strategies in mind.

The range displayed on each job posting reflects the targeted base salary for the position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description

Guardian is seeking a Data Engineer to join the team responsible for establishing and maintaining an optimized, scalable data pipelines to provide access to high quality, consistent data in an easy and convenient manner to all authorized end users and applications of Guardian and its subsidiaries.  
  
As a Data Engineer, you will play a vital role in our data infrastructure and analytics ecosystem. You will work closely with data architects and data scientists to build and maintain data pipelines, transform raw data into actionable insights, and contribute to the development of cutting-edge data solutions. This is an excellent hands-on opportunity to experience the latest technologies and make a significant impact on our data-driven initiatives. The position will integrate new data sources from enterprise sources and external vendors using a variety of ingestion patterns including Structured Query Language (SQL) Ingestion, File, and Application Programming Interfaces (APIs).

You will

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and translate them into effective data pipelines.
* Design and maintain reliable batch and real-time ingestion pipelines for databases, files, APIs, event streams, and third-party data sources, including schema evolution, error handling, and data quality controls.
* Develop and operationalize scalable data pipelines using Python, PySpark, and SQL to transform ingested data into curated, trusted, and business-ready data assets.
* Leverage Databricks to build, orchestrate, optimize, and govern production-grade data pipelines and data assets.
* Build governed, high-quality data assets that support analytics, machine learning, and generative AI use cases.
* Design scalable dimensional and domain-oriented data models, define schemas and data contracts, and optimize data structures for performance and usability.
* Implement observability, automated data-quality checks, and proactive alerting to ensure pipeline reliability, performance, and compliance with service-level objectives.
* Participate in code reviews, testing, and documentation efforts to maintain high-quality code and data documentation.
* Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in data engineering.
* Continue to look for innovative and next generation solutions for solving data challenges.

You are

A self-starter, self-motivated team player and have excellent communication skills, enabling you to engage with all levels of stakeholders who is fueled by collaboration, able to transform conceptual designs into reliable, scalable processes that meet or exceed customer needs. An individual who works closely with IT and business leaders across the enterprise to drive and embed the Enterprise Data Strategy into transformational roadmaps ensuring key principles of Data Governance, Data Management, Data Analytics and Architecture are implemented.  
  
You have

  

* 10+ Years of IT experience, with 5+ years of experience as a Data Architect, data engineer or other data professional
* Expert knowledge of relational and NoSQL database concepts, with hands-on experience across PostgreSQL, Oracle, Databricks, and cloud-native data stores.
* Expert proficiency in logical, physical, dimensional, and domain-oriented data modeling, including schema design and data contracts; experience with enterprise modeling tools is preferred.
* Extensive hands-on data engineering experience with distributed data processing and lakehouse technologies, including Python and PySpark on the Databricks platform.
* Hands-on experience designing and optimizing large-scale data pipelines and data-warehouse architecture using batch and incremental processing, change data capture, orchestration, and schema evolution.
* Experience with AWS data services and modern cloud data platforms, including Amazon S3, PostgreSQL, and Databricks.
* Demonstrated expertise with data sourcing, profiling, data mapping and data analysis.
* Expert SQL skills, including complex query development, performance optimization, data transformations, and scalable data-structure design.
* Ability to design secure, scalable cloud-native data solutions across object storage, lakehouse platforms, SaaS integrations, relational databases, and NoSQL data stores.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and creative problem-solving skills.
* Ability to adapt to changing business priorities and experience effectively communicating changes across different levels in the organization.
* Communication Skills: Articulate the vision and goals, both to the team members and other stakeholders.
* Emotional Intelligence & Empathy: Motivate, inspire, and resolve conflicts with others while building a positive rapport with team members and partners.
* Collaboration: Collaborate effectively with the Product Manager and your leadership and keep appraised with key updates and planning. Encourage partnership between team members to create a more dynamic and effective work environment.
* Strong listeners and able to provide constructive feedback.
* SAFE experience and the ability to work on a cross functional, self-organizing development teams is a plus.

* Significant experience interfacing with both customers and management across business and IT
* Reltio proficiency and Agentic AI development with Bedrock

Location

  

* New York NY, Holmdel NJ or Bethlehem PA .
* Up to 10% travel within the NY/NJ/PA locations

**Salary Range:**

$99,150.00 - $162,885.00

The salary range reflected above is a good faith estimate of base pay for the primary location of the position. The salary for this position ultimately will be determined based on the education, experience, knowledge, and abilities of the successful candidate. In addition to salary, this role may also be eligible for annual, sales, or other incentive compensation.

At Guardian, you’ll have the support and flexibility to achieve your professional and persona

jobs.title: Staff, Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Enterprise AI (EAI) builds the data foundations that GSK's AI systems depend on. In our operating model, digital workers do the hands-on data engineering. They generate pipelines, test and deploy them, monitor them in production and remediate failures. Our engineers design the system those digital workers operate in.

At the centre of that system is a governed context layer. It makes data, meaning, permissions and history retrievable at the moment they are needed, and sits above our data platforms and beneath every experience and agent built on them.

The Staff Data Engineer is accountable for implementing and evolving the governed context layer that humans and digital workers use across EAI, and is EAI's internal authority on data architecture for AI.

* **Owns the governed context layer** as the shared foundation every human and digital worker in EAI relies on, accountable for its architecture, implementation and evolution.
* **Defines the system digital workers engineer within** through the standards, frameworks, contracts and guardrails that let them build and operate pipelines safely, consistently and at scale.
* **Raises the standard of data engineering for AI** across EAI through the architecture, governance and engineering practices others adopt, and through the senior engineers the role develops.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Context & Semantics

* **Implement and evolve the governed context layer** as a product: one layer across enterprise knowledge, structured data, business vocabulary and modelled ontologies, queried by humans and digital workers at run time.
* **Build the capabilities the layer depends on:** reliable cataloguing across structured and unstructured data, AI-assisted metadata enrichment, context design for each use case, secure agent access over standard protocols such as MCP, and routing across sources.
* **Make certified meaning machine-readable** so that every number a digital worker returns resolves to one governed definition, with clear ownership and lineage.

Agent-Operated Data Engineering

* **Define the architecture standards and shared frameworks** that digital workers use to generate, test, deploy and monitor pipelines, reducing the integration cost of each new AI initiative.
* **Set the operating model for agent-generated engineering work:** what digital workers do autonomously, what requires human approval, how quality is evaluated and how incidents escalate. Lead the incidents digital workers cannot resolve, from detection to permanent resolution.

AI Data Infrastructure & Lifecycle

* **Shape EAI's AI data infrastructure strategy** across feature engineering, vector and retrieval infrastructure, streaming data flows and evaluation data design, building shared components that multiple AI initiatives depend on in production.
* **Define EAI's MLOps data practices:** versioning, lineage, drift monitoring, evaluation dataset governance and model data lifecycle management, extended to the context and evaluation data that digital workers rely on.

Governance & Responsible Data

* **Define EAI's responsible data governance standards for AI pipelines,** covering privacy, consent, PII, auditability and bias controls, and encode them in the governed context layer so humans and digital workers apply them by default.
* **Shape data quality and lineage at scale** across multiple data domains, with measurable outcomes in error rates, downstream AI performance and audit readiness.

Platform & Infrastructure

* **Design EAI's data platform architecture** with infrastructure as code throughout and platform-as-product thinking, so new data and AI projects start quickly and consistently.

Standards & Technical Leadership

* **Define data engineering standards** for code, documentation and review, written to be followed by humans and digital workers alike, and drive their adoption across EAI.
* **Develop senior engineers** towards greater architectural independence, and partner with forward deployed engineers (FDEs), ML engineers, platform engineers and domain experts on the data requirements of production AI systems.

**Basic Qualification**

* 10+ years of data engineering experience, including experience defining data architecture for production AI or machine learning (ML) systems.
* Experience building data infrastructure for AI systems, including feature stores, vector databases, retrieval architectures, streaming data pipelines and evaluation datasets.
* Experience building context, metadata or semantic infrastructure used by AI systems, such as data catalogues, business glossaries, knowledge graphs or ontologies, exposed to AI agents through protocols such as Model Context Protocol (MCP).

* Experience defining data quality, lineage and governance standards for AI pipelines across multiple data domains, including privacy, consent, personally identifiable information (PII) handling and auditability.
* Experience with cloud data platforms and infrastructure as code, including experience setting engineering standards.

**Preferred Qualification**

**JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way**.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

**Position Overview**
---------------------

The Lead Business Systems Analyst is the functional domain lead for client Integrated Workplace Management System (IWMS) implementations on IBM TRIRIGA and Maximo, including Maximo Application Suite (MAS) and Maximo Real Estate and Facilities (MREF). This role is the functional authority on how the platforms should solve a client's real estate and facilities challenges: it sets the solution direction, makes and owns functional design decisions, and directs the business analysts who carry out detailed requirements and testing work. The Lead Business Systems Analyst works directly with client domain leaders and with globally distributed onshore and offshore delivery teams, and is accountable for the quality of all functional deliverables on assigned engagements.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Domain & Functional Leadership**

* Serve as the functional authority for IWMS domains on assigned engagements, including space, portfolio, lease administration, maintenance, asset lifecycle, and sustainability.
* Lead discovery and solution-visioning sessions with client stakeholders, and define the future-state process and functional solution approach.
* Lead fit-gap analysis against TRIRIGA and Maximo out-of-the-box capabilities, and make the call on configure, extend, or change process.
* Make and document functional design decisions, favoring configuration-first, upgrade-safe approaches and requiring business justification for any customization.
* Resolve complex and cross-domain functional questions that BAs escalate.

### **BA Team Direction & Quality**

* Direct the work of business analysts on assigned engagements, including scoping and estimating BA effort, assigning work, and setting priorities.
* Review and approve requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional designs produced by the BA team.
* Ensure requirements traceability and UAT readiness through oversight of BA deliverables.
* Approve UAT entrance and exit criteria and defect severity definitions in partnership with QA and the client.
* Set and enforce functional standards, templates, and quality expectations across workstreams.

### **Client Partnership**

* Serve as the trusted functional advisor to client domain leaders, such as heads of real estate, facilities, and workplace operations.
* Advise clients on platform capabilities, limitations, and best practices to inform scope, design, and roadmap decisions.
* Facilitate agreement among stakeholders with competing priorities.
* Identify functional risks and scope changes early and escalate them with clear options and recommendations.
* Present functional recommendations and status to client and JLL project leadership.

### **Solution Design & Integration**

* Partner with solution architects and technical leads on integrations between TRIRIGA, Maximo, and enterprise systems, including ERP, HRIS, financial systems, IoT platforms, and business intelligence tools.
* Own the functional approach to integrations and data migrations, including data ownership, mapping strategy, and validation approach.
* Confirm functional readiness for go-live and provide functional direction through cutover and hypercare.

### **Mentorship & Practice Development**

* Mentor and coach business analysts, building their domain knowledge and client-engagement skills.
* Develop reusable domain frameworks, templates, and best practices for the BA practice.
* Lead training and knowledge-transfer sessions, including for teams moving from TRIRIGA to MAS and MREF.

---------------------------

* 8+ years of experience in business analysis or business systems analysis, including leading BA work on enterprise system implementations.
* 8+ years of hands-on experience with IBM TRIRIGA or Maximo, with working knowledge of the other.
* Experience as the functional lead on multiple full-lifecycle implementations, from discovery through go-live and hypercare.
* Experience directing the work of other business analysts, including reviewing and approving their deliverables.

* Familiarity with MAS deployment on Red Hat OpenShift and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).

* You're **self-motivated and adaptable**, comfortable managing competing priorities and working independently in a remote environment.
* You bring **fresh ideas and an innovative mindset**, always looking for opportunities to improve processes and create value.

At Rize Credit Union, we're more than a financial institution. We're a team of people committed to making a difference through **knowledge, access, and care**.

jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

Claude is trained and served on hardware in data centers Anthropic operates and in sites partners build and run for us. DCSE secures that footprint: the sites, the hardware moving through them, and the people and vendors who touch it. Security at that scale runs on data, and you'll be the engineer who owns it and the systems that produce it: component-level hardware inventory and chain of custody, fed by software that runs at our sites and on hosts, and continuous control monitoring, with the posture calculations that decide what each site is cleared to run.

You set the architecture, agree schemas and interfaces with the teams, operators and vendors that own the sources, build the pipelines, stores and tools, and run what you ship. The goal is security that runs itself: custody, access and evidence verified continuously from records, with tools and AI agents doing the reviews. We favor simple, standard controls and tools that can be verified over elaborate ones. We use Claude throughout our engineering workflow and expect you to as well.

You'll work with the rest of DCSE, including the engineers on its security monitoring platform, with Anthropic's compute and data center operations teams, and directly with data center operators, hardware vendors and logistics providers. The role is based in San Francisco, with remote applicants in the US considered, and involves regular travel to data center sites, which are critical infrastructure.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Hardware inventory and chain of custody:** own the component-level record of what hardware exists, where it is and who has handled it: the data model, the pipelines that join inventory and custody events from many source systems, change history on every record, and the tamper-evident stores behind it
* **Tools, automation and AI agents:** build the tools and agents the team runs on this data: reconciliation, audit evidence exports, custody checks. When a review keeps costing people time, you build the tool or agent that retires it
* **Custody workflows and field software:** build the workflows and the site and host software that capture custody events as they happen (a receipt, a move, a data wipe, a decommission) and enforce who is authorized to record them
* **Continuous control monitoring and posture:** own the pipelines that turn check outcomes, assessment results and findings into per-control and per-site measures over time, against the compliance frameworks we and our partners are assessed against, and the posture calculation that decides what a site is cleared to run
* **Data quality:** build coverage checks, reconciliation against sources and alerts on a silent or drifting feed, so a wrong or missing record is caught the same day; own retention and access controls on the records
* **Integration and reporting:** agree schemas and interfaces with the engineers who run the security monitoring platform, and build the query surfaces and reports the team, site leads and leadership use directly

* Have designed and run production data systems (relational schemas, change data capture, batch or streaming pipelines and the services around them) and kept them correct: coverage measured, records reconciled against the source, alerts on silence, and a design that expects records to get corrupted or lost
* Have integrated with systems you did not control (inventory tools, ticketing systems, vendor APIs) and built data models that outlive any one source
* Have shipped software that runs outside a central service (host agents, site-local services, edge collectors) and kept it correct in the field, or built metrics a team made decisions on and defended them when challenged
* Have worked hands-on with data about physical assets or security controls: a hardware fleet, data center or supply chain inventory, asset custody, or the control and evidence data of a security or compliance program
* Read and review other people's code, and build with AI coding agents using Git and code review
* Own a domain end to end: set the approach, design and build it with the teams and vendors whose systems it depends on, and run it as something people use every day
* Write SQL and at least one general-purpose programming language well

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with asset management, supply chain or warehouse systems where serialized tracking and custody transfer are the core problem
* Experience building continuous control monitoring or metrics for a security or compliance program, or producing evidence an assessor accepted, for example against NIST SP 800-53, ISO 27001 or SOC 2

* Familiarity with data center hardware and its lifecycle from receipt to decommission, and with sites and parties you did not control: colocation, cloud or GPU cloud operators, hardware manufacturers, logistics providers

**About Troveo**

Troveo builds the data platform that AI labs and model builders need to train the next generation of models. We have created the world's largest licensed platform of scarce, proprietary data for AI, spanning video, audio, text, and business workflows.

Troveo indexes, enriches, and packages this high-quality data into formats ready for training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and agentic use cases. Backed by top investors, we’re a small, high-impact team solving one of the biggest bottlenecks in AI development.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a versatile, hands-on Data Engineer to build and maintain a scalable analytics data warehouse while contributing to data modeling, performing data analysis, and ensuring reliable data delivery to downstream teams and systems. This hybrid role combines core data engineering responsibilities with data modeling, analytics, and operational support. You will own the full analytics data lifecycle, from ingestion and transformation to modeling, quality assurance, and timely delivery, while partnering closely with software engineers and business stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

Data Pipeline Engineering

* Design, build, and maintain ELT/ETL data pipelines (batch and streaming), optimizing for performance, reliability, scalability, and cost.

* Design and implement conceptual, logical, and physical data models (including dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schemas).
* Build and maintain transformation layers using modern tools (e.g., dbt) to create clean, well-documented, analytics-ready datasets.
* Apply data modeling best practices, versioning, testing, and documentation to ensure consistency and reusability.

Data Analysis & Reporting Support

* Support the creation of reports, dashboards, and self-service analytics assets in collaboration with data analysts and business teams.

Operational Support & Data Deliveries

* Monitor data pipelines and data delivery processes to ensure SLAs for timeliness, freshness, and accuracy are consistently met.
* Proactively identify, troubleshoot, and resolve data issues impacting downstream consumers or business operations.
* Manage incidents related to data availability and quality; participate in on-call rotations as needed.
* Implement data quality checks, observability, and alerting to maintain high reliability of data deliveries.
* Automate operational tasks and continuously improve data delivery processes.

Collaboration & Best Practices

* Work cross-functionally with analysts, data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders to understand data needs and deliver solutions.
* Document data pipelines, models, lineage, and processes.
* Contribute to data governance, security, and best practices across the data platform.

* Solid understanding of data modeling techniques and dimensional modeling.
* Experience performing data analysis and working with BI/visualization tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar).
* Proven ability to troubleshoot data issues and support operational reliability/SLAs.
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Bonus Points**

* Experience with DBT for data transformation and modeling.
* Knowledge of data observability/monitoring tools.
* Experience with real-time/streaming data technologies (Kafka, Flink, etc.).

* **Base Salary**: $160,000 – $175,000 (depending on experience and location)
* **Equity**: Competitive equity package in a well-funded AI startup with significant upside

**What We Offer**

* **Comprehensive Health Benefits**: Medical, dental, and vision coverage (100% employer-paid for employees)

**Company Description**

Palmetto is a consumer energy platform that provides homeowners with a single destination to discover, purchase, finance, install, monitor and manage home energy products and services. By offering one integrated platform across solar, battery storage, HVAC, heat pumps and more, Palmetto helps homeowners make home energy more affordable, reliable and accessible. Today Palmetto serves hundreds of thousands of homeowners, across 30+ states, building the operating infrastructure for the consumer energy transition, one home at a time.

Our employees are our most valuable resource. We foster a promote-from-within culture that prioritizes talent development, career growth, and purpose-driven work. Palmetto offers a comprehensive benefits package—including unlimited PTO, medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid parental leave, retirement plans, and more—so you can have it all both personally and professionally. Palmetto prioritizes people, planet, and profit—backed by a culture that values collaboration, impact, and balance. Join us in building a brighter, cleaner world.

**Location**

This position will be remote based in the United States.

**Reporting**

This position will report to the Senior Manager, Data Engineering.

**Summary of Role**

You will own the technical design of the data platform that powers Palmetto's products, partners, and AI agents. Our data spans the whole customer journey: sales, lending, installation, interconnection, and years of system production. You will turn it into one governed, trustworthy view of the business, with each metric defined once so every dashboard, notebook, and agent returns the same answer. You will also build the secure, authorized, auditable path that lets people and systems use that data directly.

This is a high-leverage individual-contributor role. You'll set technical direction, write foundational code, and work closely with core platform and product teams. AI agents are first-class consumers of our platform, and we build with them every day.

**Strategic & Tactical**

* **Communicate.** Partner with finance, operations, product and engineering to understand how their data requirements are evolving.
* **Build the access path.** Design and operate the secure, authorized, low-latency interface through which products, partners, and agents consume data.

**Qualifications**

* 8+ years in data engineering, including time at a Staff or lead level owning a platform used by multiple teams.
* Deep experience in SQL and Python.
* Strong database fundamentals in a modern analytical warehouse (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery): schema design, query plans, distributed computing.
* Deep experience with dbt or an adjacent transformation framework (e.g., SQLMesh, Dataform).
* Experience with ETL orchestration (e.g., Fivetran, Airflow).

*Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check.*

jobs.title: Data Engineer, Ingestion Platform
jobs.description:
**Location**
------------

Remote

**Employment Type**
-------------------

Full time

**Location Type**
-----------------

Remote

**Department**
--------------

Product and Data

**Compensation**
----------------

* $155K – $165K • Offers Equity

  

Alt is unlocking the value of alternative assets, starting with the $5 B trading-card market. We let collectors buy, sell, vault, and finance their cards in one place and we are backed by leaders at Stripe, Coinbase, Seven Seven Six, and pro athletes like Tom Brady and Giannis Antetokounmpo. Our next frontier is real-time pricing at scale—the Alt Value that powers every trade, loan, and product on the platform.

**The Role**
------------

Alt Value is our moat. It is only as good as the data underneath it — and that data lives on dozens of external marketplaces and auction houses that have no interest in making it easy for us to get.

That's this job. You own the pipelines that scrape, normalize, and land every transaction and listing that feeds our pricing model. When a comparable sale closes on eBay or at a major auction house, how fast it shows up in Alt Value, and whether it shows up correctly, is your call and your consequence. Pricing decisions, cash advance terms, market analytics, and every dashboard in the company sit downstream of you.

**The metric you own: Data Coverage.** Supporting KPIs are pipeline latency, uptime, and source coverage.

**What You'll Own:**
--------------------

* **The ingestion layer.** Design, optimize, and own the pipelines that scrape, process, and ingest transaction and listing data from major auction houses and marketplaces. Scraper to orchestrator to warehouse, end to end.
* **Build for reuse first.** Most of the ingestion stack — auth handling, retries, session and proxy management, monitoring — should generalize across sources. Go deep and custom only where a specific source's structure actually requires it.
* **Knowing before we do.** Build the monitoring and alerting that tracks latency, uptime, and coverage across every source. A source going quiet should page you, not surprise a pricer three days later.
* **Making it cheaper and steadier.** Modernize storage and processing, cut manual intervention out of the loop, and optimize for cost, performance, and reliability.
* **The consumers.** Partner with pricing, ML, product, and analytics to deliver data clean and standardized enough that nobody downstream is writing defensive code around your output.

**How You'll Use AI Here:**
---------------------------

We don't want to hear that you use Claude every day. Everyone does. We want to know what you've built with it. Concretely, in this role:

* Point an agent at a **site that just changed its markup** and have it propose the parser fix, run it against a fixture set, and open the PR
* Build a **triage loop over the orchestrator** — cross-reference a failed DAG against logs and warehouse state, diagnose the cause, and hand you a ranked list instead of a wall of red
* Use **LLM extraction for the long tail** of low-volume sources where a bespoke scraper will never pay for itself
* Put an **MCP server over the warehouse** so a coverage question is a sentence, not another one-off query
* Use **Claude Code or Cursor** as the default way you work through a migration or a backfill, not as autocomplete

If you've built agents, written skills or MCP servers, wired up connectors, or shipped internal tooling your team actually depends on — lead with that.

**What You Bring:**
-------------------

* 3-4 years in data engineering or a closely adjacent seat.
* Modern web scraping at scale — Playwright or comparable, plus the ability to impersonate a real browser at the network layer (TLS/request fingerprinting) when a plain HTTP client gets flagged. Selenium alone doesn't cut it anymore.
* Strong Python, 3+ years hands-on. Solid SQL for analysis and transformation.
* A pipeline you owned end to end in the past two years. Not a pipeline you contributed to. One that was yours when it broke.
* Judgment on when to generalize and when to go bespoke — you don't rebuild the same infrastructure per source, and you don't force a one-size-fits-all approach onto a source that needs custom handling.
* Orchestration in your hands, not your resume. Airflow, Dagster, or a comparable DAG system — you've built on it, been paged for it, and cleaned up after it.
* Cloud development experience (AWS, GCP).
* LLM-based extraction and processing at scale (e.g. LLM-as-a-Judge, Agent loops), not just UI-based Q&A and simple Skill building.
* Startup experience. You understand the pace, and you've worked somewhere the roadmap changed under you.
* A pragmatic bias. Value delivered incrementally over the perfect rebuild.

**Bonus:** large-scale dataframe processing (Pandas, Polars, PySpark). You collect, or you have opinions about the collectibles market.

**How We'll Interview You:**
----------------------------

We'll be specific so you can prepare. *Before any of it: download the app, put a card up, make a bid, or put a card up for sell. Every round assumes you've used the product, and we expect your point of view to sharpen as you go.*

**1. Recruiter screen - 30 minutes** Come ready to talk about the metric you own today, why Alt specifically, and how you're actually using AI. We'll answer your questions and align on comp.

**2. Hiring manager with Dae, Head of Data — 30 minutes.** Be ready to go deep on one pipeline you owned end to end: the systems design, what you owned versus the team, where it broke, and what came out the other side.

**3. Coding screen — 45 minutes.** A working session on a data problem close to what this role actually does.

**4. Systems design — 60 minutes.** Design an ingestion system under real constraints. We'll push back on at least one of your choices on purpose — how you take that matters as much as the design.

**5. Cross-functional — 60 Mins** How you work with the people downstream of your data.

**6.

jobs.description:
Join Workiva's GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) Enablement team to build the transactional data foundations that power our product teams. As a Staff Data Engineer, you'll own Postgres schema design, transactional data models, and the extraction layer that feeds our OLAP systems. You'll work alongside an OLAP specialist on this team (same manager) to jointly own GRC data outcomes end to end, transactional models through BI and history marts, and you'll partner closely with the platform data team on shared infrastructure and tooling. Your job is to make sure GRC product teams have data systems that are reliable, well-modeled, and easy to build against, and to raise the data fluency of engineers across the org.

  

This is a heavily hands-on role. You'll design schemas, define extraction and CDC patterns, and mentor engineers who need to write better queries and reason about relational data at scale. Together with the OLAP specialist on this team, you'll own the full data lifecycle for GRC: transactional models, BI marts, and history marts.

  

**What you'll do**
------------------

*Transactional database design & operations*

* Design, review, and evolve Postgres schemas for GRC product services, balancing normalization, query performance, and application ergonomics.
* Set standards for indexing, constraints, partitioning, and connection pooling; identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in production.
* Own migration strategy and tooling (schema changes, backfills, zero-downtime deploys) across services.

*OLTP-to-OLAP extraction (owned) / transformation (shared boundary with OLAP)*

* Own change-data-capture and extraction: what leaves Postgres, in what shape, on what cadence, and how upstream schema changes are communicated before they break downstream models.
* Define the data contract at the landing zone with the OLAP specialist so extraction output is stable and well-documented; you own upstream reliability, they own what happens after landing.
* Where dbt/ETL logic sits closer to source-of-truth semantics (e.g., early-stage transaction or history-mart models), collaborate with the OLAP specialist to determine ownership on a per-project basis, documented explicitly rather than left implicit.

*Data modeling & query performance*

* Establish relational modeling patterns and review standards so engineers build consistent, maintainable schemas.
* Optimize SQL for transactional workloads (query plans, indexing strategy, lock contention, multi-join performance at scale).
* Define data contracts between services so schema changes don't silently break consumers, including downstream OLAP consumers.

*Reliability, security & compliance*

* Implement data integrity checks, replication/failover practices, and monitoring for transactional data health and extraction pipelines.
* Work within regulated release pipelines using GitOps/CI/CD; manage schema and pipeline promotions through dev/test/prod with gated approvals.
* Apply RBAC, audit logging, and encryption standards aligned with Workiva's information-protection policies, at the OLTP layer and extraction layer specifically.

*Technical leadership & enablement*

* Establish schema design patterns, SQL coding standards, and documentation so engineers can confidently build against Postgres without escalating every decision.
* Mentor engineers on relational modeling, query optimization, and transactional system fundamentals; lead incident resolution and root-cause analysis for production data issues, including extraction failures.
* Partner with the OLAP specialist to define and document where responsibility splits, and revisit that boundary as the platform matures.
Partner with the platform data team on infrastructure decisions (warehouse provisioning, streaming infra, CI/CD tooling) while retaining ownership of GRC-specific schema design, modeling standards, and data quality outcomes; this team owns the "what and how" of GRC data models, platform data team owns the "on what infrastructure."  

  
  

**What you'll need**
--------------------

*Minimum qualifications*

* 5+ years in data engineering or backend engineering with hands-on ownership of production Postgres (or comparable relational OLTP) systems.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.  

  

*Preferred qualifications*

* Expert-level SQL and strong understanding of query planning, indexing strategy, and transactional isolation levels.
* Proven experience owning schema design and migrations for production Postgres services at scale.
* Experience building CDC/extraction pipelines (Debezium, Kafka Connect, or similar) feeding a cloud warehouse.
* Experience in regulated or highly controlled environments with strict release governance and compliance requirements.
* Familiarity with connection pooling (PgBouncer or similar), replication, and backup/recovery strategy.
* Working knowledge of dbt sufficient to collaborate on shared models, even if dbt isn't your primary tool.
Track record of mentoring engineers and driving cross-team technical standards.  

  
  

Travel Requirements & Working Conditions

Reliable internet access for any period of time working remotely, not in a Workiva office

**ABOUT US**

At Vida, we help people get better- and we're helping the healthcare system get better, too.

Vida is a virtual, personalized obesity care provider that uses evidence-based treatment to help patients manage obesity and related conditions like diabetes, high blood pressure, anxiety and depression. Vida's team of Obesity Medicine-Certified Physicians, Registered Dietitians, Expert Coaches and Licensed Therapists takes a whole-person approach to care, helping people lose weight, reduce stress and improve their overall health.

By combining advanced technology with top-notch healthcare providers, Vida is breaking down the barriers that have historically kept people from getting the best care. It's trusted by Fortune 100 companies, major national payers and large providers to enable their employees to live their healthiest lives.

Vida is looking for a Senior Data Engineer to help shape the data platform that supports much of Vida's business. Our team builds and operates the systems that ingest, validate, transform, and serve data across Vida. We work with data from health plans, employers, clinical programs, and internal systems across member identity, eligibility, claims, billing, reporting, and analytics. You will own data systems and domains end to end, from ingestion and validation through storage, transformation, and delivery. You will make architecture decisions, change production systems safely, and help other engineers make good decisions about data infrastructure.

### **Responsibilities:**

* Own production data systems and domains from ingestion through delivery.
* Design ingestion patterns that handle incomplete, duplicated, delayed, malformed, and changing partner data.
* Define the contracts between source systems, ingestion, transformation, and downstream consumers.
* Design data models with clear grain, keys, history, and definitions so the same question doesn't get two different answers.
* Evolve schemas, pipelines, and datasets safely, with retries, backfills, and replay that don't corrupt or duplicate data.
* Improve pipeline performance, observability, and failure handling so you can tell when something is wrong and why.
* Work with Engineering, Product, Operations, and Analytics to figure out what the data needs to represent when requirements are incomplete or messy.
* Additional responsibilities as needed.

### **Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree at a minimum.
* 5+ years building production data systems.
* Strong SQL and data modeling fundamentals, including grain, keys, history, dimensional modeling, and the tradeoffs between different representations of the same data.
* Experience designing and operating batch and asynchronous data pipelines, including the failure modes that appear in distributed systems.
* Experience with a cloud data platform and an understanding of storage, query performance, and cost.
* Strong instincts around data correctness, including validation, idempotency, late and duplicated records, schema changes, backfills, and reprocessing.
* Working proficiency in Python for pipelines, services, tooling, and tests.
* The ability to change production systems in ordered, reversible steps without breaking their consumers.
* Clear written communication, including documenting technical decisions and explaining changes to people outside of engineering.

jobs.title: Data Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
**CANDIDATES MUST BE LOCATED IN THE UNITED STATES OR CANADA**

**About SafelyYou**

SafelyYou’s passionate mission is to empower safer, more person-centered care across senior living through world-leading AI, industry-changing hardware, and remote expert clinicians, significantly improving outcomes for residents while increasing peace of mind for families and reducing costs for communities.  
  
Originating in 2015 as the doctoral research of CEO George Netscher—and inspired by his own family's experience with Alzheimer's disease—SafelyYou was spun out of UC Berkeley’s Artificial Intelligence Research Lab, one of the top five AI research groups in the world. And today, our company is solving critical challenges in senior living, from resident falls and ER visits to staffing concerns, length of stay, and NOI. All helping ensure that communities can focus on improved care for residents while still reaching their financial goals.  
  
SafelyYou is one of five most innovative fall technologies referenced in the Senate Falls Report (2019), a winner of the McKnight’s Tech Partner of the Year, and has been named to Fortune’s Impact 20 list, which recognizes companies making people’s lives better through innovation.

**Your Role at SafelyYou**  
  
As a Data Integration Engineer at SafelyYou, you will be the subject matter expert behind how our internal systems communicate with the outside world. You will design, build, and operate robust integration pipelines that transform data between our internal event-based architecture and the diverse formats required by our third-party API partners. You will play a critical role in scaling our external data exchange capabilities, handling complex payload mappings, and ensuring that our systems gracefully manage failure modes at scale.

You will work closely with R&D architects, other data engineers, backend developers, and cross-functional teams to define and implement integration patterns for webhooks, external REST APIs, and partner platforms. Additionally, you will own technical communications for integrations, managing Go-Live data backfills and writing clear API specifications for customer-facing documents.

This is a fully remote role. You are expected to work with minimal guidance, act as a subject matter expert for integration patterns, and proactively identify opportunities for architectural improvement.  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design, build, and operate robust integration pipelines to ingest data from and push data to third-party APIs, webhooks, and custom endpoints.
* Transform, normalize, and map data payloads between SafelyYou’s internal schema and external partner specifications (e.g., JSON/XML schemas, third-party platforms).
* Performing validation on data received from third-parties, segregating data that fails validation, and automating processes with third-parties to resolve anomalies.
* Manage and execute complex data backfills and Go-Live integration pipelines for new customer rollouts.
* Write and maintain clear, high-quality technical documentation and API specifications for both internal engineering teams and external partners.
* Triage, troubleshoot, and gracefully handle integration failure modes, rate limits, and edge cases at scale, building resilient retry mechanisms.
* Scale our ability to support 3rd party integrations by building systems and tooling to allow non-engineer users to configure, monitor, and perform backfills for third-party integrations.
* Ensure data quality, consistency, and reliability by developing automated tests and validating payload outputs with ongoing pipeline monitoring.
* Work in an Agile environment to plan, track, and improve the delivery of new integration features and products.
* Collaborate with customer support, operations, and product teams to provide technical support and participate in on-call rotation as needed.

**Requirements:**

* 5+ years of professional experience in software, backend, or data engineering, preferably in a startup environment.
* Deep hands-on experience building, consuming, and operating integrations with REST APIs, webhooks, and third-party platforms.
* Strong programming proficiency in Python and SQL for building reliable data transformation and integration pipelines.
* Proven track record of handling complex data transformations, schema mapping, and payload normalization across disparate systems.
* Experience encountering and solving API failure modes and operational challenges at scale (e.g., implementing exponential backoff, dead-letter queues, idempotency). Has seen where things fail and can recommend solutions to maintain a stable platform.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with specific experience writing technical documentation, ADRs, or API specs.
* Proactive about anticipating and addressing data ingestion issues before they impact the business.
* Prioritize quality over speed. When it is done, it is really done.

**The Ideal Candidate:**

* Proficiency with modern data stack tools, such as dbt and PySpark.
* Familiarity with workflow orchestration concepts and tools, such as Airflow.
* Exposure to Terraform and Cloud Infrastructure, such as AWS (Athena, RDS, EKS).
* Experience with electronic health records (EHR) and associated data privacy regulations (e.g., HIPAA) is a strong plus.
* Experience with HL7 data feeds and the FHIR API specification is a huge plus.
* Experience with remote work and distributed, async-first engineering teams.

**Join us in creating a better way!**
=====================================

At eHealth, our mission is to expertly guide consumers through their health insurance and related options when, where, and how they prefer. We’re creating a better way – one that’s transparent and trustworthy for both our consumers externally and our employees internally.

Move your career forward while connecting countless people to the life- changing, quality care they deserve. Our diverse team of innovators supports one another in solving some of the toughest challenges. We’re always on the lookout for creative opportunities to do right by our customers, and each other. Together, we’re creating a better way to work, united by our common passion to make a difference.

At eHealth, we're working to make health insurance more accessible, affordable, and easier to navigate for Americans nationwide. We're looking for an experienced, motivated Senior Data Engineer to join our data team. You'll take a lead role in designing scalable, high-performance data pipelines, architecting data solutions, and driving analytics and machine learning initiatives across the business. You'll partner closely with data scientists, software engineers, and business stakeholders and mentor other engineers to ensure our data is reliable, accessible, and actionable, powering mission-critical decisions in a fast-paced, regulated industry.

jobs.description:
#### **What is PerfectServe?**

PerfectServe is a leading provider of clinical communication and physician scheduling solutions in the health IT space. The company was founded in 1997 and has grown steadily since then, with a notable jump after several major acquisitions were announced in 2019. PerfectServe now has 400+ employees, 30,000+ customers — spanning medical practices, hospitals, and health systems — and $100 million+ in annual revenue.  
  
PerfectServe's mission is to accelerate speed to care by optimizing provider schedules and routing communications — including messages, pages, calls, and alerts — to the right place at the right time in any care setting. By facilitating real-time information sharing, building better schedules, and automating important clinical workflows, we believe we can help our customers advance patient care and improve the well-being of their clinicians.  
  
Leading analyst firms like Gartner® and KLAS Research have consistently validated our approach:

* In 2026, PerfectServe was named highest in execution and furthest in vision in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Clinical Communication and Collaboration — the clear segment leader.

* PerfectServe also received two Best in KLAS awards in 2026 — one for physician scheduling and another for ambulatory clinical communications. That makes for 11 Best in KLAS awards over the past 9 years.

At PerfectServe, you'll have a unique opportunity to join a collaborative team with decades of experience that finds new ways to delight our customers every day. This involves consistent efforts to stay on the cutting edge of product development, which includes everything from implementing AI in new and existing solutions to brainstorming with customers about novel workflows. But you don't have to be in product to make in impact — everybody at PerfectServe contributes to important work that moves the business forward.  
  
If you're looking for a well-established, tech-forward company full of smart people doing meaningful work, you've found the right place!

**About the role**
------------------

Join a new, small team building PerfectServe's data platform.

We are building the pipelines and models that bring data together from across PerfectServe's product portfolio. You will work closely with a staff data engineer and a platform engineer, with enough ownership to see your work in production and enough support to learn quickly.

The source systems are varied, so the work spans extending established pipelines and designing new ones from scratch. That range is a good part of the job.

**Why this role, specifically**
-------------------------------

Joining a platform in its first months is a different experience from joining one that is five years old. The patterns are still being set, which means your questions change them. You will see the whole path — a production source system at one end, someone making a decision at the other — rather than one layer of a stack somebody else assembled.

You will have a dedicated team to work with and learn from so the ownership comes without being thrown in unsupported.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Build and maintain ingestion pipelines from production source systems
* Write transformation models that turn raw data into datasets people can trust
* Apply dimensional and medallion modelling patterns as the warehouse takes shape
* Deploy pipelines to production, and test them properly — idempotency, data quality checks
* Contribute to data model and schema design, and to design reviews
* Document what you build, including runbooks for the pipelines you own

**What you bring**
------------------

* Professional experience building data pipelines, with production ownership of at least some
* Strong SQL, and a working programming language — Python, Go or equivalent
* Hands-on dbt, or another transformation framework
* A cloud data warehouse — Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift or similar
* Practical ELT and orchestration experience (Fivetran, Airflow or equivalent)
* Working AWS knowledge — object storage, access basics, and enough networking to reason about where data moves
* A testing instinct for data, not only for code

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Change-data-capture
* SQL Server sources
* Healthcare or another regulated data environment
* Exposure to a BI or semantic layer

#### **Why Join PerfectServe?**

At PerfectServe, we are transforming healthcare communication and collaboration to help clinicians deliver better care. You'll work with a dedicated and mission‑driven team in an environment that values growth, transparency, and innovation.

We offer a salary range of **$115,000–$140,000 USD** per year, with compensation tailored to your background, strengths, and growth potential. This range reflects our commitment to pay transparency and is based on market data, internal equity, and the scope of responsibilities. Compensation is determined by several factors, including experience, skills, and team impact. We regularly review compensation to ensure fairness and consistency. Current employees with questions are encouraged to connect with their manager or People Operations.

#### **Benefits:**

* Remote first work environment
* Health, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability Insurance options available day one.
* 401K - with match and immediately vested.
* 17 company holidays, 2 floating holidays plus competitive paid time off policy
* Internal Advancement Opportunities

PerfectServe offers unified healthcare communication solutions to help physicians, nurses, and care team members provide exceptional patient care. PerfectServe's cloud-based solutions enhance patient safety and reduce provider burnout by automating workflows, speeding time to treatment, optimizing shift schedules, empowering nurse mobility, and engaging patients in their own care.

The DAS team owns the data behind the scenes for our retail applications and reporting teams. You'll support production data systems, build and maintain ETL pipelines, and help lead the team's ongoing migration of our data warehouse from Teradata to Snowflake, with AWS Glue and continued mainframe decommissioning on the roadmap for the next 6–12 months.

This role will partner closely with other engineering, BA, and reporting teams that consume DAS owned data, including application teams like the Data Integration Hub, to keep data flowing reliably across the business.

We're looking for someone who already has hands-on data engineering experience and is comfortable working with real autonomy. This team moves quickly and gives engineers real ownership.

jobs.title: Big Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Big Data Engineer is a remote engineering review track for evaluating production code, debugging traces, and developer-facing AI outputs against real-world correctness standards. Reviewers reproduce failures, write the unit test the model should have written, and explain the fix so the modeling team can target the gap.

**Why this role matters**
-------------------------

Engineering model quality lives or dies on whether the generated code actually compiles, passes tests, and handles edge cases. AuraOne pairs experienced engineers with the modeling team to grade outputs the way a code reviewer would.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Run and reproduce candidate code outputs in a sandboxed environment for Big Data Engineer assignments.
* Grade data engineering solutions for correctness, style, and edge-case handling.
* Write minimal failing tests that demonstrate the bug a model output missed.
* Compare paired solutions and rank them with a written rationale tied to the rubric.
* Tag failure modes (compile error, runtime crash, off-by-one, security issue) with severity scores.
* Document recurring code-generation failures so the modeling team can target them.
* Calibrate against gold-standard reviews to keep inter-rater agreement above target.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Strong day-job engineering experience — you can read, run, and debug unfamiliar code for Big Data Engineer work.
* Comfort writing concise unit tests that capture a single failure mode.
* Familiarity with a testing framework. pytest, Jest, or JUnit. Go test, RSpec, or whatever you use.
* Clear written reasoning — your review note has to convince another senior engineer.
* Reliable async availability for at least 10 hours per week.
* Prior code-review or technical-interview-grading experience is a plus.

**Example tasks**
-----------------

* Reproduce a generated engineering solution to a coding task, run the test suite, and grade it.
* Write the smallest failing test that demonstrates a model's edge-case bug.
* Compare two paired solutions and rank them with a written rationale tied to the rubric.
* Triage a security issue surfaced by a model and document the patch the model should have produced.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Open-source contributions or a public portfolio that demonstrates production-quality code.
* Experience with the target language's standard tooling, linters, and idiomatic style guides.
* Familiarity with security-review checklists (OWASP, CWE) and AppSec patterns.

**Skills**
----------

* Code review
* Debugging
* Unit testing
* Software engineering judgment
* Data engineering

**Work model**

Remote — US-eligible. Remote · Independent specialist contractor. Employment type: CONTRACTOR. Applicants must be authorized to work from US.

**Compensation**
----------------

Hourly rate confirmed after the interview process.

Apply through AuraOne's specialist intake for role-specific routing and review. Final project scope, schedule, and contractor terms are confirmed before placement.

jobs.title: Senior Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
### **This is a Remote Position. US based role only. No HB-1 Visa Support** **OUR VISION**

Equs is a company building privacy-first AI, identity, and trust infrastructure for the agentic era. The digital world was built around platforms, not people. AI is rewriting what software can do, and we have a narrow window to make sure that future puts the individual at the center rather than further behind. We start from one conviction: your digital identity should belong to you, travel with you, and give you real agency in how you show up online. You set the rules, you hold the keys, and you benefit from your own data.  
  
We are building toward that future across every layer it requires: the infrastructure that makes it possible, the standards that make it interoperable, and the experiences that bring it to life for the people who use it. We are early, and we are clear about what is built today and what is still ahead. The people who use what we build keep control of their own data, and we hold ourselves to that standard in everything we make.

### **WHAT YOU WILL DO**

We’re taking the EQUS Developer Toolkit to organizations of all kinds, from banks and other regulated institutions to employers, education providers, public bodies and digital platforms, and every one of them needs someone technical on our side to get them live. This is our first dedicated integration hire and a hands-on, customer-facing role. You’ll be the technical lead for each customer from the first architecture call to the first credential in production: designing the solution, connecting their identity and back-end systems, and guiding them through security review. You’ll bring what you learn back into the product and the docs, and help shape how integration works as the team grows. You may be required to work on other EQUS products over time. Your day-to-day includes, but is not limited to:

* Designing each customer’s solution, turning use cases such as KYC status, employee or student IDs, qualifications, age checks, membership and AI-agent payment mandates into a Developer Toolkit design (issuance and presentation flows, wallet model and build method) that the customer’s architects can sign off
* Running technical onboarding, provisioning sandbox and production tenants, issuing client credentials, setting up Issuers, Verifiers and credential schemas with the customer, and enabling and tracking on-request features such as the Web Wallet, AP2 agent flows and quota increases
* Connecting customer identity systems, guiding IAM teams through Bring Your Own IdP (OpenID Connect), Authorization Server registration and OAuth client-credentials setup in both directions
* Getting back-end integrations live, specifying and reviewing each customer’s Attribute Provider endpoint and helping their engineers debug using request IDs, error codes and rate-limit headers
* Supporting front-end teams as they embed our UI within strict security policies and allowed-origin rules, apply their branding, and enable the browser Digital Credentials API where devices support it
* Leading EU Digital Identity Wallet readiness, from moving Verifiers to X.509 and securing registration certificates from national Registrars to configuring trusted roots
* Owning the technical side of security and procurement, answering due-diligence questionnaires and joining security reviews using our data-handling, encryption, DPA and TOMs documentation
* Supporting business development in technical sales conversations, helping prospective customers understand what an integration involves and helping us close our first deals
* Acting as the customer’s voice to product, logging and prioritizing the gaps that block deals and working with our engineering team and partners on fixes
* Making every integration faster than the last, writing quickstarts, help-center articles, sample code and a reusable customer integration pack with sector variants, including a flow decision tree, security answers and a go-live checklist

### **WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO SUCCEED**

You combine deep technical skill with real empathy for customers, and you’re as comfortable with a bank’s IAM team as with a startup’s two developers. You’re fluent in OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect and can work out why a token is rejected, you can read an OpenAPI spec and write enough back-end code to build sample integrations, and you understand PKI well enough to untangle a certificate chain. You write clearly, whether it’s an integration design, a security answer or public documentation. You are comfortable with ambiguity, because parts of our product are still being built and you’ll design around the roadmap. You are self-directed in a remote setting, managing your own time and keeping several customer integrations moving at once.

### **YOUR EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

This role calls for 4 or more years in a customer-facing technical role such as solutions engineer, integration engineer or technical consultant for an API or identity product. You’ve personally taken enterprise customers from pilot to production, ideally in regulated or security-conscious sectors such as banking, insurance, government, healthcare or education, including security reviews and vendor due diligence. You bring hands-on experience with REST APIs and at least one back-end language (TypeScript/Node, Java/Kotlin or Python), and a working understanding of X.509 certificates, trust anchors and key management. Experience with verifiable credentials and digital identity standards (OID4VCI, OID4VP, SD-JWT VC, ISO 18013-5 mdoc), eIDAS 2.0 and the EU Digital Identity Wallet ecosystem, enterprise identity providers such as Microsoft Entra, Okta or Ping, and payments, open banking or agentic-payment protocols like AP2 are all a plus.
